content: make the title appear immediately, I've refactored the `/product` page to isolate the blocking `getInventory` call

. 

By extracting the data fetching logic into a separate asynchronous `Inventory` component and wrapping it in a React `<

Suspense>` boundary, Next.js can now immediately stream the `

Premium Widget

` title down to the client while the inventory

data continues to fetch in the background.

This enables a fast navigation transition from the home page.
